# ==============================================================================
# File: brainstorm/CMakeLists.txt
# Purpose: build the Archi "board" viewer (archi-board) and, optionally, its test programs.
#
# How it fits: board.cpp starts a Qt Quick app that loads ArchiBoard.qml and a board JSON generated by
# build-map.mjs. The reusable C++ pieces (DocumentFiles, MathEngine, DocumentSync) are NOT in this repo:
# they live in a sibling checkout of the Archi project at ../../archi relative to this folder, so this
# build only works when that checkout exists next to the repo. No cmake is installed on the machine where
# this comment pass was done, so the file was not configured or built there.
# Configure and run: see brainstorm/README.md ("cmake -S brainstorm -B brainstorm/build -DBOARD_TESTS=ON").
# ==============================================================================

# 3.21 or newer; C++17 is what the Archi headers use; AUTOMOC lets Qt generate its meta-object code for
# QObject classes declared in headers.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(archi_brainstorm LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

# Qt 6 modules the viewer needs: Qml/Quick for the UI, QuickControls2 for the Fusion style set in board.cpp.
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Qml Quick QuickControls2)

# Location of the sibling Archi checkout and the three header-only components compiled into the viewer.
set(ARCHI_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../archi")
set(ARCHI_HEADERS "${ARCHI_SOURCE}/src/DocumentFiles.h" "${ARCHI_SOURCE}/src/MathEngine.h" "${ARCHI_SOURCE}/src/DocumentSync.h")

# The viewer executable. The two definitions bake in absolute paths of the Python interpreter (a virtualenv
# inside the Archi checkout) and the math_engine.py script that MathEngine launches for symbolic math.
add_executable(archi-board board.cpp ${ARCHI_HEADERS})
target_compile_definitions(archi-board PRIVATE ARCHI_MATH_PYTHON="${ARCHI_SOURCE}/.venv-math/bin/python" ARCHI_MATH_SCRIPT="${ARCHI_SOURCE}/src/math_engine.py")
target_link_libraries(archi-board PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Qml Qt6::Quick Qt6::QuickControls2)

# Tests are opt-in (-DBOARD_TESTS=ON) so a normal build does not need the Qt test modules.
option(BOARD_TESTS "Build board interaction tests" OFF)
if(BOARD_TESTS)
    find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS QuickTest Test)
    # board-tests runs tests/tst_board.qml through tests/setup.cpp (the QtQuickTest runner); the compile
    # definition tells it where the QML test files are.
    add_executable(board-tests tests/setup.cpp ${ARCHI_HEADERS})
    target_link_libraries(board-tests PRIVATE Qt6::QuickTest Qt6::QuickControls2)
    target_compile_definitions(board-tests PRIVATE QUICK_TEST_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests")
    target_compile_definitions(board-tests PRIVATE ARCHI_MATH_PYTHON="${ARCHI_SOURCE}/.venv-math/bin/python" ARCHI_MATH_SCRIPT="${ARCHI_SOURCE}/src/math_engine.py")
    # sync-tests is the plain QtTest suite for DocumentSync (tests/test_sync.cpp); it needs no GUI.
    add_executable(sync-tests tests/test_sync.cpp "${ARCHI_SOURCE}/src/DocumentSync.h")
    target_link_libraries(sync-tests PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Test)
endif()
